headline: MapmyIndia partners with Mumbai Metro to provide real-time metro data via Mappls app
hook: Real-time metro data to boost MapmyIndia usage
summary: C.E. Info Systems Limited announced that Mumbai Metro Rail Corporation Limited is partnering with MapmyIndia's Mappls platform to deliver accurate, real-time metro information through the app. The collaboration aims to improve commuter experience and expand MapmyIndia's data services. It involves a government metro operator and a listed mapping firm, affecting MapmyIndia and C.E. Info Systems shareholders. Retail investors may note the potential revenue uplift for MapmyIndia.

headline: MapmyIndia partners with MathWorks for ADAS validation
hook: New partnership targets Indian ADAS development
summary: C.E. Info Systems, known as MapmyIndia, has announced a collaboration with MathWorks to improve Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) validation for Indian roads. The partnership integrates MapmyIndia's high-definition mapping data with MathWorks' simulation software. This initiative aims to accelerate the testing and deployment of autonomous and assisted driving technologies tailored to local road conditions. The collaboration is expected to enhance the company's position in the automotive technology ecosystem.
why_it_matters: Strengthens MapmyIndia's role in the growing Indian autonomous vehicle market.
winners_losers: MapmyIndia gains / Automotive tech competitors face pressure
